4262.title: [skia-sync] Merge upstream chrome/m148 bug fixes into release/4.148.x
4262.body:
[skia-sync] Merge upstream chrome/m148 bug fixes into release/4.148.x (#4262)

Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/1a155bae3a...9bf10f9f96
Companion: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/268

Automated release-line bug-fix sync for the m148 release branch. This is not a
milestone bump (current == target == 148): no version files change and the only
edits are the externals/skia submodule pointer and the matching cgmanifest.json
SHAs.

Re-points externals/skia from 1a155bae3a to 9bf10f9f96 — the tip of mono/skia
release/4.148.x after the companion skia-sync merge (mono/skia#268) landed,
rather than the interim skia-sync branch commit. cgmanifest.json mono/skia
commitHash and the Skia-core upstream_merge_commit are updated to match.

Upstream commits pulled in via the bump:

  * 46f2e16555 [m148] Resolve a data race on fStream in SkTypeface_Mac — the
    user-visible fix; eliminates a gTFCache/fStream race in SkTypeface_mac_ct.
  * 3a90f6662a [graphite] Use stable collection for static bindings — benign for
    SkiaSharp, which ships Ganesh rather than Graphite/Dawn.

No C/C++ public API, C API shim, or generated bindings changed: the binding
generator re-ran with no diff, and ABI/soname stay at libSkiaSharp.so.148.0.0.
No managed C# or test changes were required. Linux x64 native build, full
binding build, and the test suite (5544 passed, 172 HW-skipped) pass; the
remaining platforms rebuild on the release-line CI once this lands.

Co-authored-by: Matthew Leibowitz <mattleibow@live.com>
Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

4217.title: [docs] Remove superseded doc-automation workflows from release/4.148.x
4217.body:
[docs] Remove superseded doc-automation workflows from release/4.148.x (#4217)

Companion to #4207.

Doc-automation was unified on main into a single update-release-notes pipeline
that opens one rolling bot/release-notes PR carrying both the API diffs and the
release notes. main's Prepare phase walks every release/* ref and reads v* tags
itself, so it already regenerates this line's pages centrally. The branch-local
copies left on release/4.148.x are now redundant — and one of them is actively
harmful:

  * update-release-notes.md + .lock.yml — the OLD notes-only variant. It still
    triggers on push:[release/**] + v* tags with preserve-branch-name, so every
    push opens a duplicate per-version dev/release-notes-4.148.x-* PR alongside
    the unified one. This is what produced the duplicate PRs #4172, #4208,
    #4210, and #4213.
  * api-diff.yml — deleted from main when API diffing was folded into the
    unified pipeline. Inert here (its push trigger is [main]-only and schedule
    crons don't run on non-default branches), but dead cruft that no longer
    matches main.

Remove all three so release/4.148.x fully defers to main. No content is lost:
main regenerates this line's release notes and API diffs on its daily run.

Co-authored-by: Matthew Leibowitz <mattleibow@live.com>
Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

4212.title: Bump to the next version (4.148.1) after release
4212.body:
Advances the release/4.148.x integration branch to 4.148.1 now that 4.148.0 has
been cut, so future builds on this line don't collide with the released version.
Bumps SkiaSharp file/nuget to 4.148.1 and HarfBuzzSharp file/nuget to 14.2.0.1
(lockstep packaging revision), and SKIASHARP_VERSION to 4.148.1. Assembly
versions stay pinned (SkiaSharp 4.148.0.0, HarfBuzzSharp 1.0.0.0) and the
milestone/soname lines are unchanged.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
